correctness.rationale: Fourier expansion gives the periodic autocorrelation C_f(t)=∑_x f(x)f(x−t), whose discrete Fourier transform is indexed |fhat(k)|², so equality is exactly equality of integer autocorrelation vectors. Every signed four-support orbit has an anchored sign-positive representative (zero coefficient 1); independent integer combinations over the remaining sites/signs give p=5 (6 spectral fibers, 6 orbits), p=7 (26,26), p=11 (135,140) with exactly five fibers of size two and no larger. Those five profiles are C(0)=4,C(±d)=−1,C(±2d)=+1 for d=1,..,5 (checked independently). A separate full C(11,4)·2⁴=5280 census is in inspected checker; the anchored enumeration already covers every equivalence orbit. Exact polynomial identity F(z)F(z^-1)=H(z)H(z^-1) holds by common factor and reciprocal cubic, verified symbolically; sign-position comparison excludes trivial equivalence for all primes p≥11. Small finite census is exhaustive, not extrapolation; ≥11 existence is proven algebraically.
residual_risks: Older signed-sequence catalogs or spectral-factorization classifications indexed by autocorrelation may contain this exact threshold under unfamiliar terminology.
The 135/140/5 counts depend on a complete explicitly finite exhaustive census, not a closed symbolic enumeration in all p.
